import re
text=open('src/lib/krb5/unicode/ucdata/uctable.h').read()
def arr(name):
    m=re.search(r'static const krb5_ui_4 '+re.escape(name)+r'\[\] = \{(.*?)\};', text, re.S)
    vals=[int(x,16) for x in re.findall(r'0x[0-9a-fA-F]+', m.group(1))]
    return vals
nodes=arr('_uckdcmp_nodes')
decomp=arr('_uckdcmp_decomp')

best=[]

for r in sorted(best, reverse=True)[:100]:

print('count',len(best),'nodes',len(pairs),'decomp',len(decomp))
